source: test/sessions/T1/T1-1-1 (runtime + payloads, 2026-10-01): arcs at msg 77; last canon request (payload index 229)

arcs.text: The party must take a posting and form a party before the Guild will send them out.
The Wendhope posting: a silent mining village offering suspiciously high coin.
Belle and Dalan are both seeking a party and may join the player's.
Tobias keeps drawing attention to the Wendhope notice, pressing the party toward that posting.
Ellie is quietly matchmaking the player with Belle and Dalan to form a new party.
Belle has thrown down a challenge to Max to prove her axe is more than decoration, and the exchange is unresolved.
Dalan has asked Max directly whether he is looking for a party, and Max has not yet answered.
Tobias has not yet written the party's name in the ledger for the Wendhope job, leaving the commitment unconfirmed.
The party must decide whether to accept an A-rank problem disguised as a D-rank posting.
The Grey Pennants must survive an A-rank threat disguised as a D-rank posting in Wendhope.
Belle's challenge to Max about her axe being more than decoration remains unresolved.
The Grey Pennants must gather gear and depart Aegis City at first light for Wendhope.
Belle's warning that she is not a decoration leaves an unresolved tension with Max over how he treats her.
The Grey Pennants still need to agree on a plan for Wendhope before departing at first light.
The Grey Pennants have reached silent, walled Wendhope and must discover why the village stopped talking.
The party must confront whatever left the trail of dead, eyeless bodies along the north road.
The Grey Pennants must discover what killed the eyeless bodies along the north road and why Wendhope has gone silent.
The Grey Pennants must find a way into walled, silent Wendhope after receiving no answer at the gate.
The party must identify the source of the faint scraping sound coming from inside Wendhope's walls.
The Grey Pennants must convince the terrified, starving villagers of Wendhope to open the gate and let them in.
The Grey Pennants must learn why Wendhope's runners never returned and what is scraping on stone inside the walls.
The Grey Pennants must get past Wendhope's refusal and the archers on the wall to enter the village before sundown.
The Grey Pennants must reach the west postern gate and get inside Wendhope before the sun sets.
The Grey Pennants must learn why Wendhope's wall screams at night.
The Grey Pennants must learn what happened to the Sheridans and the missing runners.
The Grey Pennants must hold the crumbling south wall near the old quarry through the night.
The Grey Pennants must survive the first wave of Screechers now striking the south wall.
The Grey Pennants must find a way to kill Screechers that do not fall when struck.
The Grey Pennants must stop the Screechers from carrying wood and scaling the south wall with ladders.
The Grey Pennants must stop the Screechers breaching the east wall.
The Grey Pennants must learn what the white flowers left by dead Screechers signify.
The Grey Pennants must discover what became of the defenders and villagers of Wendhope now that the night is over.
The Grey Pennants must deal with the breach on the east wall before the next nightfall.
The Grey Pennants must learn who now leads Wendhope with Sheridan gone quiet.
The Grey Pennants must prepare for the fog's return and the next night's assault.
The Grey Pennants must find Mayor Duggy at the town hall and learn what he knows about the forest.
The Grey Pennants must find out who now runs the mine with the foreman dead.
The Grey Pennants must see the tunnel the miners opened and learn what Duggy is hiding about the quartz lode.
The party must follow Duggy into the mine tunnel and confront whatever the miners uncovered among the glowing roots.
The party has followed Duggy into the mine tunnel against his orders and must face whatever is scraping on the stone ahead.
The party must decide how to handle Duggy, who wanted to go down alone and may be hiding what he knows about the roots.
The party must decide how to answer Duggy for disobeying his order to stay above ground.
The party must face whatever is scraping on the stone ahead in the root-filled tunnel.
Wendhope's wall is short on arrows while Halena counts them, leaving the defenders under-supplied.
The party intends to enter Needlehaven to find where the pale roots begin.
The party must decide whether to heed Duggy's plea to stay back or push forward to him.
The party has disobeyed Duggy and entered the root-filled tunnel, and must face the scraping thing and the strange echoing voice ahead.
The party must decide how to answer Duggy, who begged them not to come closer.
The party now faces the Screecher assault in Needlehaven forest at dusk, standing their ground among the roots.
The party is now inside Needlehaven forest at dusk, facing the first wave of Screechers among the roots.
The strange echoing voice in the tunnel and what Duggy was waiting to see remain unexplained.
